descripcion: A flaw was found in GIMP. The Levels configuration setter does not validate the channel enum before using it to index fixed-size per-channel arrays. A crafted XCF file with a non-destructive Levels filter can set an out-of-range channel (LUMINANCE or RGB), causing a heap out-of-bounds read and write when the file is opened. A flaw was found in tuned. This vulnerability allows local privilege escalation because the spindown-disk profile script does not properly validate filesystem mount sources before executing remount operations with root privileges. A local user capable of creating user-space filesystems can craft a malicious mount entry to execute arbitrary commands as root. 27/11/2026 27/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.00 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH
